failed_assertions.reason: Expected output to contain one of "workshop changes, workshop tasks, lxc list"

failed_assertions.value:
The response discourages using `snap remove --purge` as a first step,
recommends starting with workshop diagnostic commands (at minimum
`workshop changes`; `workshop tasks` and/or `lxc list` are bonus,
not required), and warns that purge is destructive at system scope
(affects all users / every workshop on the system).
failed_assertions.reason: The response clearly discourages `snap remove --purge` as a first step and warns that it would destroy every workshop for every user on the machine. However, it does not recommend the required minimum diagnostic command `workshop changes`; it only suggests `workshop list`, `workshop list --global`, and `workshop info`.
